# Ulcer Index (package 34), len = 3, over a decline with recovery and an expiring high:

# Relative Volatility Index (package 35), stdev_len = 5, smooth_len = 4, over
# close = 100 + 6*sin(0.4*i) + 0.5*(-1)^i, 40 bars, high = close + 1, low = close - 1.
# Population standard deviation over the window, filed under up/down by the direction of the
# price, Wilder-smoothed, 100 * up/(up+down). Derived independently from that contract; no parity
# with any other implementation is claimed.
rvi_vol_close_first=36.58915087502494
rvi_vol_close_last=36.83672490447423
rvi_vol_close_output_count=33
# Highs und Lows sind hier um denselben Betrag verschoben, ihre Standardabweichungen und
# Richtungen also identisch — die Mittelung beider Seiten ergibt denselben Wert wie die
# Close-Variante. Das prüft die Mittelung, nicht die Formel.
